strategies.name: procedure.output.strategy
rules: Define WHAT and WHY; no HOW.
Use paragraph headers; no bullets as headers; single spacing.
Include Documented Information table and MDL linkage sentence.

strategies.name: wi.output.strategy
rules: Provide step-by-step HOW; include screenshots/placeholders as allowed.
May reference systems generically; proprietary details allowed.

strategies.name: form.output.strategy
rules: Define fields, owners, and retention category (A/B/C).

strategies.name: output.audience.auditor
strategies.tone: Peer-to-peer, technical, cites standards by clause
strategies.example: AS9100 8.5.3 gap: Change board charter lacks 'risk assessment' language. Severity: HIGH. Recommendation: Add XYZ to board charter.

strategies.name: output.audience.operator
strategies.example: Your change control process isn't documenting the risks of changes. Here's why that matters: [explanation]. Here's how to fix it: [simple steps].

strategies.name: output.audience.executive
strategies.example: 3 critical gaps found. 2 require <1 week to remediate (cost: $5K). 1 requires process redesign (cost: $25K, timeline: 4 weeks).
